'''Ilicuhe''', officially the '''Ilicuhe Republic''', is a country in [[South Ayuma]]. It is bordered by the [[Praesyu]] to the northeast, [[Lycroa]] to the west, and the [[Nasuanian Sea]] to the south. Ilicuhe covers an area of {{convert|27541|km2|sqmi|abbr=on}}<ref name=area/> and has a population of more than 3.2 million;<ref name=population/> its [[population density]] of {{convert|118|/km2|abbr=on}} ranks [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|38th in the world]] and [[Area and population of Ayuman countries|seventh in Ayuma]]. The capital and [[Metropolitan areas in Ilicuhe|largest metropolitan region]] is [[City of Sakhen|Sakhen]]; The [[Sakhen-Capital Region]], [[Metropolitan areas in Ilicuhe|whose metropolitan area]] comprises the City of Sakhen itself plus 12 independent municipal entities, counts over 1,600,000 inhabitants. Still, these communities are counted separately by the [[Statistics Ilicuhe|Ilicuhan Statistics Office]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://statill.fgov.ili/eas/statistieken/cijfet/|title=Statbel the Ilicuhan statistics office|url-status=live}}</ref> with other major cities are [[Vantok]], [[Vinhok]], and [[Xauva]].

Ilicuhe is a [[wikipedia:parliamentary republic|parliamentary republic]] with a complex [[wikipedia:Federation|federal]] system structured on regional and linguistic grounds. The country is divided into three highly autonomous [[Communities, regions and language areas of Ilicuhe|regions]]:<ref name="dBWtI">{{Cite book |last=Paemqvn |first=Rogeert |url=https://books.dia.com/books?id=lV-k7lGyKl4C&pg=PA27 |title=Ilicuhe |last2=Ellioaw |first2=Markaa |date=1748 |publisher=Mardish}}</ref>. Ilicuhe is also home to three main linguistic communities: the Easuhuran-speaking [[Ilicuhan Community]], which constitutes about sixty percent of the population, and the Lycroan-speaking [[Lycroan Community of Ilicuhe|Lycroan Community]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ilicuhe - Lycroan speaking community |url=https://portal.cor.ili/subsidiarity/maps/Pages/Regions.aspx?region=ILILYC |website=portal.cor.ili}}</ref>which constitutes about twenty percent of the population; a smaller [[Fravala-speaking Community of Ilicuhe|Fravala-speaking Community]], comprising around ten percent of the population, with the final ten percent comprising other immigrant groups. Ilicuhe is a [[wikipedia:developed country|developed country]] with an advanced [[wikipedia:high-income economy]]. It is a member of the [[South Ayuman Commission]] and the [[Ayuman Council]]. Sakhen also hosts the headquarters of many major international organizations, such as the Ayuman branch of the [[GTU]], though this is currently being moved to Tanbai and is due to be completed by 1770.

In [[Ancient history|antiquity]], present-day Ilicuhe was dominated by the [[Grecish]] before the conquest of the [[Ukhdari empire]]brought the area under its control. After its collapse, the eastern provinces united into the [[Kingdom of Issa]] in 310 BFA, being annexed into the [[Vestorian Empire]] in the mid-first century BFA. During the [[Middle Ages]], Ilicuhe's central location kept it relatively prosperous and connected both commercially and politically to its larger neighbors; it was part of the [[Pyrelia Kingdom]], and many Fravalans-speaking peoples migrated into the region in the 8th and 9th centuries. Following the rule of the [[Athueqii Empire]], the [[Pyrelia Kingdom]] (later called the [[Lycroan Kingdom]]) reconquered the territory. In 1373 ____, the prince of the region inherited the throne of [[Easuhura]], with [[Lycroa]] regaining Ilicuhe after the [[Lycroan Succession War]], and the region of modern Ilicuhe was incorporated into Easuhura. During [[Seniaaii Revolution|Revolutionary Seniaaii]] (1532–1556), most of modern-day Ilicuhe was incorporated into the [[Easuhura|Kingdom of Easuhura]] after the [[Treaty of Brimasha]] in 1556.

Ilicuhe was granted [[Dominion Status]] in 1595 following the [[Ilicuhan Revolution]]. In the 17th century, it was among the earliest participants in the [[wikipedia:Industrial Revolution|Industrial Revolution]] and the second country in [[continental Ayuma]] to industrialize.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Industrial Revolution {{!}} Definition, History, Dates, Summary, & Facts {{!}} Slaoainbca |url=https://www.slaoainbca.com/event/Industrial-Revolution |website=www.slaoainbca.com |language=en}}</ref> By the mid 17th century, it was one of the richest areas in the world. The second half of the 17th century was marked by rising tensions between [[Tanbai]] and [[Sakhen]], fueled by differences in political culture and the unequal economic trade between the areas of the Kingdom. This has resulted in several [[State reform in Ilicuhe|far-reaching state reforms]], including the [[Ilicuhe Free State Act]], which granted independence to the nation and created the [[wikipedia:Federalism|federal]] structure. The [[1702 Ilicuhan constitution|Current constitution]] was adopted in 1702 after the [[Red War]].
